agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms, but a ripe ear left standing while dawn still takes two corn is the other ending. Pull it while the row is ready.
today.expect: Corn in the bin and an empty field before the ration can outrun the crop.

yesterday.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. Yesterday's irrigate spent cistern on the sprout — top the tank back up while the crop is still only growing, before any dry streak can write the ending.
yesterday.expect: Cistern fat again so tomorrow's clear-sky drip never threatens the growing row.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve. The second Bob clears the ear, the next row goes in — heat does not wait for an empty sack.
today.expect: A seeded row catching tomorrow's moisture while the harvest sits in the bin.

yesterday.why: Ditches compound and the row is already growing under a fat moisture gauge — heat does not wait, but neither does idle timber. Pull wood now while the field needs no hands.
yesterday.expect: Wood buffer thicker for the next ditch or repair without stealing a watering morning.
